question: Ticket 53e7979f76e7 says "The installer's code lives at cairn/machines/installer/", but outline 1.3.2 reads "Machine: tools plus the glue that holds them together. Has an owner. Anything that calls another component, uses other tools, or owns state it must gate is a machine. Lives inside its device (cairn/devices/<device>/machines/<machine>/), or in cairn/machines/ when several devices hold one (16)." (Line 1.3.2 says machines live at cairn/devices/<device>/machines/ if they belong to one device, or cairn/machines/ only when several devices hold one. Line 6.3.5 places the installer in Recovery's section ('Install and upgrades live here'), indicating one owner. By 1.3.2's location rule, Recovery's installer should be at cairn/devices/recovery/machines/installer/, not cairn/machines/installer/ (which is reserved for shared machines per section 16).). Which stands, the ticket or the outline?
why_it_blocks: the ticket and the component outline disagree; building it would build one of them wrong
answer: The outline stands. Outline 6.3.5 (line 832) places the installer in Recovery, and the only caller of cairn.machines.installer is bin/cmd/install (grep over bin/, cairn/ and skills/, 2026-11-12), so it is held by one device and belongs at cairn/devices/recovery/machines/installer/. That misplacement predates this ticket. 53e7979f76e7 adds one function to the installer at whatever address it holds when it crosses BUILDME, and a later move carries it along. Neither the location nor the move is in this ticket's bounds. The move is not ticketed yet; it was raised with the orchestrator on 2026-11-12.
